title: Level 2 Unresolved Workspace Handoff
scenario: Customer reports post-migration workspace access loss. Context rules out login, role, and SCIM issues, but does not yet prove the remaining mechanism, so the correct outcome is handoff.
handoff_summary: Three migrated users can sign in but still cannot open the workspace. Login, role assignment, and SCIM delay are ruled out. Cache or service-side evidence still needs investigation before naming a cause.

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: Three users lost access after our migration yesterday.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: Can they sign in at all, or is login blocked?

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: They can sign in, but the workspace still will not open.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: I checked role assignment and SCIM. I am going to hand this to product support with the remaining cache check.

context_events.description: Admin context shows authentication works, workspace role is present, and SCIM completed. Cache status is not available yet.
context_events.next_check: Escalate with cache status and service incident checks still open.
